errors.evidence: The figure legend shows years 2022, 2023, and 2024 and monthly bars, but the machine description attributes the chart to 2022–2024 with a base year 2021=100. That caption text is not part of the plotted data itself and is not shown in the figure area.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос представлява месеците от I до XII, означени с римски цифри, и е разположена в азбучен ред
errors.evidence: The x-axis categories are months I–XII, but months are in calendar order, not alphabetical order.
The y-axis top tick is 140,000, but the plotted bar values do not reach 140,000; the highest bar is around 127,000–128,000.

errors.text_span: най-високите стойности са наблюдаеми в месеците VI (2022 г. – около 120,000), XII (2022 г. – около 130,000) и XII (2024 г. – около 110,000), докато най-ниските стойности са в месец VIII (2022 г. – около 80,000).
errors.evidence: The cited maxima/minima are inaccurate: month VI for 2022 is closer to 116,000, month XII for 2022 is about 127,000, month XII for 2024 is about 111,000, and the lowest 2022 value is around 81,000–82,000 in month VIII.
The description does not explicitly mention that the x-axis is a categorical axis with months ordered I–XII, which is part of the required axis description.
